meta_title: O Curioso and the Kingdom of Laughter | Humildadever Studio
meta_desc: A 2D platformer for the whole family, for Android. Six worlds, 200 levels, mini-games and a dog that never dies. From Humildadever Studio, Portugal.
game_title: O Curioso and the Kingdom of Laughter
hero_lead: King Grumpy has stolen the Great Laugh. Run and jump with O Curioso and his dog through six worlds to bring joy back to the kingdom.
hero_note: Free · Android 7.0 or later · Game in English and Portuguese
story_p1: O Curioso is a boy who never stops asking "why?". When King Grumpy steals the Great Laugh and the kingdom turns grey, he sets off on an adventure with his loyal dog.
story_p2: Jump, double jump, climb ladders, bounce on springs and ride moving platforms. Find the lost laughs, earn up to three stars per level and face bosses with their own attacks.
fam: O Curioso's companion is always safe. No violence and no scares.
Buttons or joystick, a left-handed mode and large buttons for small hands.
The adventure works without internet, at home, in the car or on a trip.
From version 14 on, an ad only appears when the player chooses to watch one for a reward.
From version 14 on, the game has no real-money purchases.
Daily challenge, Survivor mode, seasonal events and a costume shop.

worlds_p: Each world has its own scenery, music and challenge: gusts of wind, rising lava and slippery ice.
faq: Yes. It is a free download on Google Play. Coins are earned by playing or, if the player wants, by watching an ad.
Which devices does it run on?
Android phones and tablets with Android 7.0 or later.
Which languages is the game in?
The game is in English and Portuguese. This website is available in many languages.
No. You can play offline. The internet is only used for the optional ads and the Google Play Games leaderboards.
Yes. The game does not ask for personal data, has no accounts, and its ads are suitable for children and not personalised. Read the privacy policy for details.
Write to humildadeverstudio@gmail.com. We reply in English or Portuguese.
studio_p: An independent studio from Portugal that makes games and apps with imagination, humour and care for families.
